notes: §1985:XIII.3.19.3 SR1 requires a non-alphabetic SUM subject, a numeric identifier-1, a report-section identifier-1 that is a sum counter, without UPON a sum-counter addend 'defined either in the same report group that contains this SUM clause or in a report group which is at a lower level in the control hierarchy of this report', and with UPON no sum-counter addend. ScreenReportEntryPicture (MoveTable16.NumericSenderRefusal) refuses an alphabetic subject (witness, COBOL2750), ResolveSumAddend refuses a non-numeric ordinary addend (COBOL2045), ScreenRolledAddend refuses a SOURCE/VALUE report addend below 2002 (COBOL6764), an UPON with a counter addend (COBOL2730) and, through GroupCombinationPermitted, a higher-level control footing's counter (COBOL2731); but GroupCombinationPermitted is asked only when the counter is in the SAME report, so a sum counter of ANOTHER report description is accepted at 85. Probes (std 85): a) SUM T(N) of an OCCURS DEPENDING ON table element accepted, printed 1.5 (7 + -5.5) correct; b) PIC A(5) subject COBOL2750, alphanumeric addend COBOL2045, SOURCE-entry addend COBOL6764, higher-level CF counter COBOL2731, UPON with a lower CF counter COBOL2730, UPON with a same-group counter COBOL2730, UPON with another report's counter COBOL2730, group SUM entry COBOL2247; c) the 2002 SOURCE-entry addend refused (COBOL6764); d) PIC X(5) subject accepted (printed 00010, integer counter of GR1 c), signed scaled -ZZ9.9 printed - 11.0, rolling forward and same-group crossfoot accepted and printed - 11.0 twice; e) n/a (a report file is sequential output only); f) PIC 9(18) addend 18 nines summed twice: CF line printed blank (size error, undefined without ON SIZE ERROR); g) ANOTHER report's counter 'SUM ATOT OF RPT' in RPT2's control footing, no UPON: ACCEPTED, ran, printed 0.0. kb/Work PB5253 holds the defect (code read: coderead-85/out-pipe/slice-55.json).

next.reason: Kept: subject not alphabetic (§2023:13.18.54.3 SR2 'shall be valid as the category of a receiving operand in a MOVE statement for a sending operand of the category numeric'), non-report addend numeric (§2023:13.18.54.3 SR5), and no UPON with a report-section addend (§2023:13.18.54.3 SR4 a). Changed: 1985 requires a Report Section addend to be a sum counter, in the same group or a lower-level control footing; §2023:13.18.54.3 SR4 accepts any 'numeric data item in the report section' and adds pairings ('The current report group may be a detail and data-name-1 may be defined in a different detail', report and page footings, other reports), while a same-group addend now 'shall be a repeating item' with more levels of repetition, so a 1985 non-repeating crossfoot within one control footing is refused. Both looser and stricter; compile-time throughout.
